latest_release.name: v1.0.4
latest_release.body:
## 🎉 What's Changed

WeClone 1.0.4 tells you what a build will cost and how long it will take, before you start!

**Cost and time estimate**
- The confirm step of the Build portrait page estimates a build's cost, time and number of requests. A trial sends about 10 real requests to the model service to measure them, and the build reuses their answers.
- Known providers such as DeepSeek are priced at their official rates, other services at the common price across providers. For a service with off-peak prices, the estimate follows the hours a build started now would run in.
- With Codex, the estimate shows tokens and time, since Codex uses your subscription quota.
- A build starts after a trial of the saved model settings. The page tells you what is still missing before you can start.
- While a build runs, the page shows what it has spent and the time and cost still ahead, and warns you when spending runs far past the estimate. The finished page shows what the build spent.

**Build portrait page**
- Every new build starts from its own upload. Opening the page clears chats uploaded earlier, and a successful build clears the chats it used.
- When Codex reaches its usage limit, the build stops and keeps the answers it already got. Build again once the quota is back.

**Personal assistants**
- The Assistants and Portrait summary pages explain how cloud assistants such as dots, Muse and Grok Bot can use your portrait: import the exported summary into their memory or custom instructions, or send it and ask them to remember it.

**Logs**
- In encrypted mode, build logs now show the numbers of chats, requests and tokens, still without any chat text.

## ⚠️ Upgrade Notes
- A build started from the web UI reads only the chats uploaded on the Build portrait page. The `csv_folder` in `settings.jsonc` is still read by `build-profile` on the command line.

## 🐛 Bug fix
- With `deepseek-v4-pro`, about a quarter of extraction requests were rejected and sent again because the model wrote sample IDs as `#0`. These answers are accepted now (#262).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/xming521/WeClone/compare/v1.0.3...v1.0.4

## 😊 更新内容

WeClone 1.0.4 在开始构建前就能告诉你大概要花多少钱、多长时间！

**费用和用时估算**
- 「构建画像」页的确认步骤会估算这次构建的费用、用时和请求次数。试算会向模型服务发送约 10 次真实请求来测量，这些回答构建时直接沿用。
- DeepSeek 等已知服务商按官方价格计算，其他服务按各家服务商的常见价格估算。有错峰价格的服务，按现在开始构建会经过的时段计算。
- 使用 Codex 时显示 token 用量和用时，因为 Codex 用的是订阅额度。
- 开始构建前需要先用保存的模型设置试算一次，页面会提示还差哪些步骤。
- 构建过程中会显示已经花了多少、还需要多长时间和多少钱，实际花费远超估算时会提醒。构建完成后显示这次一共花了多少。

**构建画像页**
- 每次新建构建都从重新上传开始。打开页面时会清掉之前上传的聊天记录，构建成功后也会清掉这次用过的。
- Codex 额度用完时构建会停下，已经拿到的回答都会保留，额度恢复后重新构建即可。

**个人助手**
- 「助手接入」和「画像总结」页说明了 dots、Muse、Grok Bot 等云端助手怎么使用画像：把导出的画像总结导入助手的记忆或自定义指令，或者直接发给它，请它记住。

**日志**
- 加密模式下，构建日志也会记录聊天、请求和 token 的数量，仍然不含任何聊天内容。

**升级说明**
- 从网页开始的构建只读取在「构建画像」页上传的聊天记录。`settings.jsonc` 里的 `csv_folder` 仍供命令行 `build-profile` 读取。

**问题修复**
- 使用 `deepseek-v4-pro` 时，模型把样本编号写成 `#0` 这样的形式，约四分之一的抽取请求因此被判为失败并重发。现在这类回答也能正常识别（#262）。

detail.readme:
Build a portrait of your life. Assistants that know you. Clones that talk like you.

[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/xming521/WeClone?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&label=Stars&logoColor=white&color=ffda65)](https://github.com/xming521/WeClone/stargazers) [![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/xming521/WeClone?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&label=Release&logoColor=white&color=06d094)](https://github.com/xming521/WeClone/releases) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-2CA5E0?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/+JEdak4m0XEQ3NGNl) [![Twitter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Twitter-@weclone567-000000?style=for-the-badge&logo=x&logoColor=white)](https://x.com/weclone567) [![小红书](https://img.shields.io/badge/WeClone-FE2C55?style=for-the-badge&logo=xiaohongshu&logoColor=white)](https://www.xiaohongshu.com/user/profile/628109730000000021029de4)

简体中文｜ English｜ Project Homepage ｜ Documentation

WeClone distills your identity, goals, preferences and current situation from your digital life into a life portrait, organized into domains such as work, family and health, that you can review, trace and share on your own terms. The portrait serves as long-term memory for your personal assistants and will power clones with your personal style. ## ✨ Core Features - 🗺️ **Interactive life portrait**: your portrait is organized by domain and topic. Every fact traces back to its source and can be reviewed and edited. Extraction runs through Codex or any OpenAI-compatible API. - 🎭 **Your own AI clone**: fine-tune an open model on your chat history and deploy it to Telegram, Discord, Slack, Feishu and more through AstrBot or LangBot. Training data is filtered for personal information. - 🧠 **Connect personal assistants**: Claude Code, Codex, dots, Muse, Grok Bot and other personal assistants use your portrait through MCP or their memory. You choose which domains and privacy levels they get. - 🗣️ **Speaking style analysis**: 179 style features in ten categories, covering vocabulary, syntax, tone, emotion, rhetoric and conversational rhythm. - 🤖 **Agent clone** (in development): no training required. A large model drives the clone in real time from your portrait, memories and speaking style. - 🔒 **Privacy first**: encrypted local storage by default, a privacy level on every fact, and full control over what is exported and shared. > [!NOTE] > WeClone now goes beyond fine-tuned clones. The original fine-tuning workflow remains fully supported, see [Fine-tuned clone](docs/en/finetune.md). > > The portrait and its extraction prompts are currently in Chinese, and English chats have not been tested yet. The web UI is available in English and Chinese. ## 📰 Recent Updates - [26/11/03] Life portrait: `build-profile` extracts, organizes and summarizes your portrait in one command, ready for fact-by-fact review in the web UI - [26/11/03] Assistant access: Claude Code, Codex and other personal assistants read your portrait over MCP - [26/11/03] Encrypted storage by default, and token access for chat bots - [25/07/10] Telegram added as a data source - [25/06/05] Fine-tuning on image data ## 📥 Supported Data Sources The life portrait reads text messages only. The table shows the message types the fine-tuned clone supports. See [Preparing data](docs/en/data.md) for exporting and setup. | Platform | Text | Images | Voice | Video | Animated Emojis/Stickers | Links (Sharing) | Quote | Forward | Location | Files | |----------|------|--------|-------|-------|-----------------|-----------------|-------|---------|----------|-------| | Telegram | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ⚠️ Converted to Emoji | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | | WhatsApp | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | | Discord | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | | Slack | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | Chats from other platforms can be converted to WeClone's generic CSV format and placed in `dataset/csv/`. See [Preparing Data](https://docs.weclone.love/en/docs/deploy/export-chat-history#generic-csv-format) on the docs site for the format. ## 🚀 Quick Start ### 1. Install Python 3.12 is required. [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) is recommended: ```bash git clone https://github.com/xming521/WeClone.git && cd WeClone uv venv .venv --python=3.12 source .venv/bin/activate # Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate uv pip install -e . cp settings.template.jsonc settings.jsonc ``` All settings live in `settings.jsonc`. The base install is enough to build your portrait and connect personal assistants. By default the portrait is extracted through the [Codex CLI](https://github.com/openai/codex), which must be installed and signed in. Any OpenAI-compatible API works as well, see [Installation and configuration](docs/en/installation.md). ### 2. Prepare your data Telegram chats are supported today. Export them as JSON with Telegram Desktop, put the `ChatExport_*` folders in `dataset/telegram/`, then set `platform` to `telegram` and `telegram_args.my_id` to your user ID in `settings.jsonc`. Chats from other platforms can be converted to the generic CSV format and placed in `dataset/csv/`. See [Preparing data](docs/en/data.md). ### 3. Build your portrait and connect personal assistants ```bash weclone-cli server ``` Open http://127.0.0.1:5175, set a password, and build your portrait on the Build portrait page, which checks the setup and shows the progress. Then review your portrait fact by fact, approve the summaries on the Portrait summary page, then generate a token on the Assistants page and run the commands it shows for Claude Code or Codex. You can also copy the export text on the Portrait summary page into an assistant's memory. See [Life portrait and assistants](docs/en/profile.md). ### 4. Fine-tune a clone An NVIDIA GPU is required. The default Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with LoRA needs about 16GB of VRAM. Install the dependencies and download the model as described in [Fine-tuned clone](docs/en/finetune.md), then run: ```bash weclone-cli make-dataset # build training data, filtering personal information weclone-cli train-sft # LoRA fine-tuning weclone-cli server --inference --port 8005 # OpenAI-compatible API ``` Connect the trained clone to chat platforms through AstrBot or LangBot, see [Chat bots](docs/en/chatbot.md). ## 🔒 Privacy and Security - **Model services during extraction**: while building your portrait, chat content is sent to the model service you configured, after you confirm. Content already extracted is read from a local cache and not sent again. - **Encrypted by default**: the chat snapshot, portrait, training data and fine-tuned model are stored encrypted on your machine, with one password shared by the web UI and the command line. - **Access on your terms**: every fact carries a privacy level (public, normal, private, sensitive), and you set in the web UI which domains assistants can read and up to which level. - **Training data filtering**: Microsoft Presidio and your own blocked words remove personal information before fine-tuning, though 100% detection is not guaranteed. See [Security](docs/en/security.md). ## 🏗️ Architecture
Show the architecture diagram: the modules, the data flow and the files each step writes. Click it for the full-size image.
## 📚 Documentation | Document | Covers | |---|---| | [Installation and configuration](docs/en/installation.md) | What to install, model backend, speaking style and fine-tuning dependencies | | [Preparing data](docs/en/data.md) | Supported sources, Telegram export, generic CSV format | | [Life portrait and assistants](docs/en/profile.md) | build-profile, web review, portrait summary, MCP | | [Fine-tuned clone](docs/en/finetune.md) | Hardware, model download, training data, training and inference | | [Chat bots](docs/en/chatbot.md) | Bot token, AstrBot, LangBot | | [Security](docs/en/security.md) | Storage modes, password, keys and tokens, request logs | Full tutorials, configuration reference and FAQ are on the [documentation site](https://docs.weclone.love/en/). ## 📌 Roadmap - [x] Life portrait: extraction, review and portrait summary - [x] Long-term memory for personal assistants, over MCP or the portrait summary - [ ] Agent clone driven by your portrait, memories and speaking style - [ ] Support more data sources - [ ] Richer context: including contextual conversations, chat participant information, time, etc. - [ ] Multimodal support: image support already implemented - [ ] Data augmentation ## 💬 Troubleshooting - Start with the [official FAQ](https://docs.weclone.love/en/docs/introduce/FAQ). [DeepWiki](https://deepwiki.com/xming521/WeClone) can also help. - Join the Telegram group linked at the top of this page. ## ❤️ Contributing Issues and pull requests are welcome, and so is help reviewing PRs. Please discuss new features in an issue first. See the [contributing guide](docs/CONTRIBUTING.md#english) for the development environment, tests and frontend builds. ## 🙏 Acknowledgments Thanks to BUPT VCIS Lab for its support, and to the following code contributors and other community members for their contributions. This project also benefits from excellent open source projects such as [LLaMA-Factory](https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory), [AstrBot](https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot), [LangBot](https://github.com/RockChinQ/LangBot), and others. [![Powered by DartNode](https://dartnode.com/branding/DN-Open-Source-sm.png)](https://dartnode.com "Powered by DartNode - Free VPS for Open Source") ## ⚠️ Disclaimer > [!IMPORTANT] > This project is intended for learning and research. Assess the risks yourself before using it in production or offering it as a service.
Click to view the disclaimer terms - **Provided as is**: the project comes without warranties of any kind. The authors are not liable for any direct or indirect loss arising from its use and do not commit to ongoing maintenance or support. - **Data and consent**: chat history contains other people's messages. Make sure that collecting and using the data complies with local laws and that the people involved have consented. - **Portrait extraction by LLMs**: while your portrait is built, chat content, including the other side's messages, is sent to the model service you configured and handled under that service's data policy. Choose a provider you trust and check its data retention and training terms. Leave chats you don't want sent out of the data directory. - **Portrait content**: the portrait collects and infers personal information about you, touches on the people around you, and may include sensitive topics such as health or relationships. Keep result directories and exported files safe, and review the portrait before giving assistants access. - **Model output**: portraits, summaries and clone replies are generated by models. They may be inaccurate and do not represent the real views of you or anyone else. - **AI disclosure**: when a clone talks to other people, make clear that it is an AI so that no one mistakes it for a real person. - **Lawful use**: do not use this project for any unlawful purpose. This disclaimer may be revised as the project evolves.
## ⭐ Star History > [!TIP] > If this project is helpful to you, or if you are interested in the future development of this project, please give the project a Star, thank you
[![Star History Chart](https://star-history.dera.page/svg?repos=xming521/WeClone&type=Date)](https://star-history.dera.page/#xming521/WeClone&Date)

detail.readme_zh:
绘制你的人生画像，让助手懂你，让分身像你

[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/xming521/WeClone?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&label=Stars&logoColor=white&color=ffda65)](https://github.com/xming521/WeClone/stargazers) [![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/xming521/WeClone?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&label=Release&logoColor=white&color=06d094)](https://github.com/xming521/WeClone/releases) [![小红书](https://img.shields.io/badge/WeClone-FE2C55?style=for-the-badge&logo=xiaohongshu&logoColor=white)](https://www.xiaohongshu.com/user/profile/628109730000000021029de4) [![Twitter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Twitter-@weclone567-000000?style=for-the-badge&logo=x&logoColor=white)](https://x.com/weclone567) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-2CA5E0?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/+JEdak4m0XEQ3NGNl)

简体中文｜ English｜ 项目主页 ｜ 项目文档

WeClone 从你的数字生活中提炼身份、目标、偏好、近况，按工作、家庭、健康等板块整理成可审核、追溯、授权的人生画像。画像可以作为个人助手的长期记忆，也将驱动具有你个人风格的数字分身。 ## ✨ 核心功能 - 🗺️ **交互式人生画像**：画像按板块与主题逐层组织，每条事实均可追溯原文，支持逐条审核与修改。可通过 Codex 或任意 OpenAI 兼容 API 抽取画像。 - 🎭 **专属数字分身**：基于聊天记录微调开源模型，并通过 AstrBot、LangBot 部署至 Telegram、Discord、Slack、飞书等平台。训练数据经过隐私信息过滤。 - 🧠 **接入个人助手**：Claude Code、Codex、dots、Muse、Grok Bot 等个人助手可以通过 MCP 或记忆使用你的画像。提供哪些板块、到哪个隐私级别由你决定。 - 🗣️ **语言风格分析**：覆盖词汇、句式、语气、情绪、修辞、互动节奏等十大类、179 项风格特征。 - 🤖 **Agent 分身**（开发中）：无需训练，由大模型结合画像、记忆与语言风格实时驱动。 - 🔒 **隐私优先**：默认本地加密存储，每条事实标注隐私级别，导出与授权范围由你决定。 > [!NOTE] > WeClone 现在不只做微调分身。原有的微调流程完整保留，见[微调分身](docs/zh/finetune.md)。 ## 📰 近期更新 - [26/11/03] 人生画像：`build-profile` 一条命令完成画像抽取、整理与板块总结，并在网页上逐条审核 - [26/11/03] 助手接入：通过 MCP 向 Claude Code、Codex 等个人助手提供人生画像 - [26/11/03] 数据默认加密存储，聊天机器人通过令牌调用分身 - [25/07/10] 数据源增加 Telegram - [25/06/05] 支持图片模态数据微调 ## 📥 数据源平台适配 人生画像只读取文字消息，下表是微调分身支持的消息类型。导出和配置方法见[准备数据](docs/zh/data.md)。 | 平台 | 文字 | 图片 | 语音 | 视频 | 动画表情 | 链接（分享） | 引用 | 转发 | 位置 | 文件 | |------|------|------|------|------|----------|-----------|------|------|------|------| | Telegram | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ⚠️ 转为 Emoji | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | | WhatsApp | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | | Discord | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | | Slack | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 🚧 | 其他平台的聊天记录可以转换成 WeClone 的通用 CSV 格式，放进 `dataset/csv/` 使用，格式见文档站的[准备数据](https://docs.weclone.love/zh/docs/deploy/export-chat-history#%E9%80%9A%E7%94%A8-csv-%E6%A0%BC%E5%BC%8F)。 ## 🚀 快速开始 ### 1. 安装 需要 Python 3.12，推荐使用 [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)： ```bash git clone https://github.com/xming521/WeClone.git && cd WeClone uv venv .venv --python=3.12 source .venv/bin/activate # Windows 下执行 .venv\Scripts\activate uv pip install -e . # 国内镜像：-i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple/ cp settings.template.jsonc settings.jsonc ``` 所有配置都在 `settings.jsonc` 中。基础安装即可绘制人生画像和接入个人助手。画像默认通过 [Codex CLI](https://github.com/openai/codex) 调用模型，需要先安装并登录，也可以改用任意 OpenAI 兼容 API，见[安装与配置](docs/zh/installation.md)。 ### 2. 准备数据 目前支持 Telegram 聊天记录：用 Telegram Desktop 以 JSON 格式导出，把 `ChatExport_*` 文件夹放进 `dataset/telegram/`，在 `settings.jsonc` 中把 `platform` 设为 `telegram`，并在 `telegram_args.my_id` 填写你的用户 ID。其他平台的聊天记录可以转换成通用 CSV 格式，放进 `dataset/csv/`。详见[准备数据](docs/zh/data.md)。 ### 3. 绘制人生画像，接入个人助手 ```bash weclone-cli server ``` 打开 http://127.0.0.1:5175 ，设置密码后在「构建画像」页构建画像，页面会先检查配置并显示进度。完成后逐条审核画像，在「画像总结」页确认总结，再到「助手接入」页生成令牌，按页面上的命令配置 Claude Code 或 Codex。也可以在「画像总结」页复制导出文本，存入助手的记忆。详见[人生画像与助手接入](docs/zh/profile.md)。 ### 4. 微调数字分身 需要 NVIDIA GPU，默认的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 以 LoRA 微调约需 16GB 显存。按[微调分身](docs/zh/finetune.md)安装依赖、下载模型后执行： ```bash weclone-cli make-dataset # 生成训练数据，同时过滤隐私信息 weclone-cli train-sft # LoRA 微调 weclone-cli server --inference --port 8005 # 启动 OpenAI 兼容接口 ``` 训练好的分身可以通过 AstrBot、LangBot 接入聊天平台，见[接入聊天机器人](docs/zh/chatbot.md)。 > [!TIP] > **社群内有部署好的 Qwen2.5-VL 32B Bot，可以体验微调效果。** ## 🔒 隐私与数据安全 - **抽取时调用模型服务**：绘制画像时，聊天内容会发送给你配置的模型服务，开始前会请你确认。已抽取过的内容读取本地缓存，不会再次发送。 - **默认加密存储**：聊天快照、画像、训练数据和微调模型加密保存在本地，网页和命令行共用一个密码。 - **按需授权**：每条事实带有隐私级别（公开、普通、私密、敏感），助手能读取哪些板块、到哪个级别由你在网页上设定。 - **训练数据去敏**：微调前通过 Microsoft Presidio 和自定义禁用词过滤隐私信息，但不能保证 100% 识别。 详见[数据安全](docs/zh/security.md)。 ##
